description: The Prancing Pony is a timber tavern with a long polished bar along the upper-left wall. Bottles line the shelves behind it, and red-topped stools run beneath the counter. Round wooden tables and their chairs fill the open floor, each lit by candles or small lanterns. A stone fireplace burns on the right under a wide mantel, with barrels and stacked wood nearby. Above the bar, a timber stair climbs towards the upper landing. The plank floor and warm pools of amber light tie the room together, while the gaps between tables leave enough open ground to walk from the entrance to the hearth.

landmarks.description: A polished wooden bar sits beneath shelves crowded with bottles and glassware.

landmarks.description: A broad fireplace burns under a heavy mantel on the right wall.

landmarks.label: Main round table
landmarks.description: A large round table with candles and chairs occupies the lower-left half of the floor.

landmarks.label: Upper stair and landing
landmarks.description: A timber staircase rises above the bar towards the upper landing.

landmarks.label: Barrel store
landmarks.description: Large barrels are stacked along the left side beneath the bar.
